title: MARC v1: An Open-Source Multi-Agent Framework for Clinical AI Reasoning and Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2608.13476v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Multi-Agent Reasoning and Coordination (MARC), an open-source framework that replaces monolithic LLM prompting with deterministic multi-agent orchestration for clinical reasoning. MARC coordinates role-specialized agents for extraction, reasoning, answer generation, and evaluation, with explicit context passing and traceable intermediate outputs, enabling stage-wise failure attribution. We additionally introduce a Decomposer module that generates task-specific agent prompts from a plain-language description, eliminating manual prompt engineering. The framework supports both API-based and local CPU-compatible deployments and is entirely configurable via YAML, without code modifications. MARC is designed to be model-agnostic, interpretable, and accessible to clinical domain experts without programming expertise. The full framework is available at https://github.com/Penn-RAIL/MARC-v1.

translated_title: MARC v1：一个用于临床AI推理与协调的开源多智能体框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13476v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出了多智能体推理与协调（MARC），这是一个开源框架，用确定性的多智能体编排取代了单一的LLM提示，用于临床推理。MARC协调角色专化的智能体进行提取、推理、答案生成和评估，具有显式的上下文传递和可追踪的中间输出，从而实现分阶段的故障归因。我们还引入了一个分解器模块，该模块从自然语言描述生成任务特定的智能体提示，消除了手动提示工程。该框架支持基于API和本地CPU兼容的部署，并且完全通过YAML配置，无需代码修改。MARC旨在模型无关、可解释，并对没有编程专业知识的临床领域专家可访问。完整框架可在https://github.com/Penn-RAIL/MARC-v1获取。
tldr: MARC通过确定性的多智能体编排和自动提示生成，使临床AI推理变得可解释、可追踪且无需编程，从而提升了临床任务中的故障定位和可访问性。
en_tdlr: MARC enhances clinical AI reasoning by using deterministic multi-agent orchestration and automated prompt generation, making it interpretable, traceable, and accessible without programming expertise.
